mapper.select: SELECT URS.uom_id, URS.uom_rating_value, URS.description, URS.icon_content_id, URS.description_lang, URS.last_modified_by_user_login, URS.created_by_user_login, URS.last_updated_stamp, URS.last_updated_tx_stamp, URS.created_stamp, URS.created_tx_stamp, UOM.uom_id AS uomId, UOM.uom_type_id AS uomTypeId, UOM.abbreviation, UOM.description AS uomDescription, UOM.last_updated_stamp AS uomLastUpdatedStamp, UOM.last_updated_tx_stamp AS uomLastUpdatedTxStamp, UOM.created_stamp AS uomCreatedStamp, UOM.created_tx_stamp AS uomCreatedTxStamp, UOM.decimal_scale AS decimalScale, UOM.min_value AS minValue, UOM.max_value AS maxValue, UOM.abbreviation_lang AS abbreviationLang, UOM.description_lang AS uomDescriptionLang, UOM.created_by_user_login AS uomCreatedByUserLogin FROM UOM_RATING_SCALE URS INNER JOIN UOM UOM ON UOM.UOM_ID = URS.UOM_ID WHERE URS.UOM_ID = #{uomId} ORDER BY URS.UOM_RATING_VALUE ASC

SELECT URS.uom_id, URS.uom_rating_value, URS.description, URS.icon_content_id, URS.description_lang, URS.last_modified_by_user_login, URS.created_by_user_login, URS.last_updated_stamp, URS.last_updated_tx_stamp, URS.created_stamp, URS.created_tx_stamp, UOM.uom_id AS uomId, UOM.uom_type_id AS uomTypeId, UOM.abbreviation, UOM.description AS uomDescription, UOM.last_updated_stamp AS uomLastUpdatedStamp, UOM.last_updated_tx_stamp AS uomLastUpdatedTxStamp, UOM.created_stamp AS uomCreatedStamp, UOM.created_tx_stamp AS uomCreatedTxStamp, UOM.decimal_scale AS decimalScale, UOM.min_value AS minValue, UOM.max_value AS maxValue, UOM.abbreviation_lang AS abbreviationLang, UOM.description_lang AS uomDescriptionLang, UOM.created_by_user_login AS uomCreatedByUserLogin FROM UOM_RATING_SCALE URS INNER JOIN UOM UOM ON UOM.UOM_ID = URS.UOM_ID WHERE URS.UOM_ID = #{uomId} AND URS.UOM_RATING_VALUE = #{uomRatingValue}
